Then we have an interesting opportunity for you! For a small and modern production company in Zevenbergen, we are looking for enthusiastic Production Workers . You will work in a production environment where various food products are manufactured. Depending on the department, your responsibilities will include: - Operating and monitoring production machines; - Supporting the production process; - Checking the quality of the products; - Keeping your work area clean and organised; - Carrying out basic production tasks; - Learning to work with different machines and production lines. You will mainly work in the department producing rice cakes or chocolate products . Some tasks can be repetitive, and you may spend longer periods working at the same workstation. Good to know: the chocolate department can sometimes get a little messy, while the rice cake department can be dusty. When all the machines in the rice cake production area are running, the temperature can also become quite high. You will work in one shift : Monday to Thursday: 07:30 - 17:00 The position is based on a 36-hour working week . As the actual working time is 38 hours and 15 minutes per week, the additional 2 hours and 15 minutes are considered overtime.
